reason: A cron-based automation plugin that schedules local scripts, Skills, and Agent tasks, with execution history, session organization, and optional push or messaging notifications.

summaries.zh: 通过 cron 定时执行 Shell、Python、Node.js 脚本及 Skill 或 Agent 任务，并提供执行历史、会话整理和可选通知。
summaries.en: Schedules Shell, Python, Node.js, Skill, and Agent tasks with cron expressions, execution history, session organization, and optional notifications.

capabilities: Schedules and runs Shell, Python, and Node.js scripts
Allows manual task execution and records execution history and output
Sends completion notifications through configured push or messaging channels
